title: Who was the leading cgi company to work

messages.content: Who was the leading cgi company to work on Avengers Age of Ultron

The leading CGI company to work on Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) was Weta Digital. Weta Digital is a New Zealand-based company known for its high-quality visual effects work, and they played a significant role in the production of Avengers: Age of Ultron.

Some notable Weta Digital effects artists and technicians who worked on Avengers: Age of Ultron include:

* Jim Rygiel
* Jim Reardon
* Sean Phillips
* Ken Ralston

Weta Digital's work on Avengers: Age of Ultron helped bring the Marvel superheroes to life in stunning detail, with impressive CGI effects that captured the characters' movements, expressions, and interactions.
How much did Weta make from that movie

Weta Digital reportedly earned around $150 million in the United States from Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015). However, it's essential to note that this figure does not include the worldwide box office earnings, which for Avengers: Age of Ultron were approximately $1.405 billion.

In terms of revenue per screen, Weta Digital reportedly earned around $1.2 million per screen in the United States. This figure represents a significant portion of the movie's earnings, considering that the film was released in over 3,000 theaters worldwide.

To put this into perspective, in 2015, the average domestic ticket price in the United States was around $14.50 per person. Assuming an average attendance of 4 people per screen, Weta Digital likely earned around $576 million from Avengers: Age of Ultron in the United States alone.

It's worth noting that these figures are estimates and may not be entirely accurate. However, they give an idea of the significant revenue Weta Digital generated from Avengers: Age of Ultron.
